title: ETs arrived en masse after the first atomic bomb
summary: Steven Greer tells of ETs arrived en masse after the first atomic bomb, about 1945 at Earth, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: after we detonated the first atomic bomb, the ETSs came in on force in mass

plain: Steven Greer, a researcher who campaigns for the release of UFO secrets, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that after the first atomic bomb was detonated in 1945, extraterrestrials "came in on force in mass." In his telling, the bomb drew visitors to Earth in large numbers, which would mean the nuclear age is what brought humanity under alien watch.
